content:
Baik, maaf untuk kendala teknisnya! Saya sudah punya cukup informasi. Langsung saya generate full paper-nya sekarang. 🚀✅ **Job dimulai!** Editor akan auto-load hasilnya dalam **3–10 menit.**

---

Sambil menunggu, berikut ringkasan paper yang sedang digenerate:

| Komponen | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Judul Tentatif** | Building Thermal Performance of Buildings with Vertical Garden Systems in Tropical Climates: A Comprehensive Review |
| **Tipe** | Systematic Literature Review (SLR) |
| **Fokus** | Perbandingan green wall, living wall, dan green façade |
| **Output** | Konsumsi energi pendingin di iklim tropis |
| **Panjang** | 15+ halaman (full journal) |
| **Format** | IEEE-style |

---

Kalau ada yang mau ditambahin atau diobrolin sambil nunggu, saya siap! 😊

tool_calls.name: GenerateFullPaper

arguments.prompt: Building thermal performance of buildings with vertical garden systems in tropical climates: A comprehensive review. The paper should systematically review and compare all three types of vertical greenery systems (green wall, living wall/modular panel, and green façade) with a focus on their impact on building cooling energy consumption in tropical climates (Indonesia/Southeast Asia). The paper should be a full-length journal article (15+ pages), covering: (1) Introduction to building thermal performance challenges in tropical climates and the role of vertical gardens as passive cooling strategy, (2) Comprehensive literature review on thermal performance mechanisms (shading, evapotranspiration, insulation, wind barrier effects), (3) Comparative analysis methodology for reviewing existing studies, (4) Results synthesizing cooling energy reduction data across different vertical garden types, (5) Discussion and recommendations for tropical building applications. Target journal style: IEEE format equivalent.
